summary: Processed all 12 non-held services: 7 promoted to prod, 2 failed builds (cart-svc, search-api), 3 degraded in staging (email-worker and pricing-svc rolled back once each; session-svc was already live and degraded from someone else's deploy, so left as is). orders-api's build call returned empty responses, but its commit was already live and healthy in staging and prod, so it was counted as promoted with no new deploys.
